_ordering_rationale: Axon = Taser CED + cameras corporels + cloud Evidence.com. KPIs ordres: Software & Sensors revenue (engine SaaS), Axon Evidence Cloud (coeur PV recurrent), TASER segment, total net sales.

kpis.signal: Hypergrowth segment cloud+cameras: 4x sur 4 ans. Coeur re-rating Axon vers SaaS public-safety
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Software & Sensors (cameras corporelles, dock, Evidence.com cloud, warranties). 60% du CA total 2024. Modele subscription/SaaS, marges en hausse.
kpis.description_en: Software & Sensors revenue (body cameras, dock, Evidence.com cloud, warranties). 60% of 2024 revenue. Subscription/SaaS model, expanding margins.

kpis.signal: Joyau Axon: SaaS Evidence.com, +358% sur 5 ans. Sticky, monetisation par utilisateur + analytics + AI
kpis.description_fr: CA Axon Evidence & Cloud Services (Software & Sensors segment). Plateforme cloud pour videos preuves + RMS + AI. Modele par utilisateur officier, retention quasi-100%.
kpis.description_en: Axon Evidence & Cloud Services revenue (S&S segment). Cloud platform for evidence video + RMS + AI. Per-officer subscription, near-100% retention.

kpis.signal: Adoption TASER 10 (lancement 2023) re-accelere segment, +33% FY24. Cartridges = consommables recurrents
kpis.description_fr: CA segment TASER: CEDs (TASER 7/10), cartouches, batteries, garanties etendues, formation VR. Cycle de remplacement et adoption T10 portent la croissance.
kpis.description_en: TASER segment revenue: CEDs (TASER 7/10), cartridges, batteries, warranties, VR training. Replacement cycle + T10 adoption drive growth.

kpis.signal: CAGR 5 ans ~25%. Trajectoire compose Software + TASER + Drones/Dedrone
kpis.description_fr: CA total Axon. Croissance soutenue 30%+/an depuis 2020. Mix evolue vers Software & Services majoritaire des 2025.
kpis.description_en: Total Axon net sales. Sustained 30%+ growth since 2020. Mix shifts toward Software & Services majority by 2025.
